title: 第7章 流光战桃花
slug: 史上第一祖师爷全本免费-史上第一祖师爷最新章节列表
content_zh:
别说慕容嫣然见了这惨象险些干呕出来，叶葛和白袍青年也是眉头紧皱，感到反胃。
村口老桃树，焦黑枯槁的树干，配上娇艳欲滴的桃花，强烈反差落入眼中让人产生一阵阵不舒服的感觉。
桃花越是生机盎然，在这人间地狱般的环境中，越是显得诡异。
林锋正要说话，石村中突然起了骚乱，大人的喝骂声与孩子的哭闹声响成一片，所有人从不同方向，都往村外逃来，对村口的老桃树避之唯恐不及。
林锋运足目力望去，就见村落间，艳红的桃花花瓣半空飞舞，在村民身后追赶。
有被花瓣帖中的人，立刻被吸干净生命精华，变成干尸。
看到人群中奋力掩护其他人，和大家一起逃亡的小不点，林锋长松一口气，心中暗叫侥幸。
幸亏遇到了慕容嫣然等人，否则老桃树这么快就动手，他还真没什么办法对付这老妖。
面对追出村外的桃花，林锋大叫一声，抱头逃窜，似乎受了很大惊吓。
慕容嫣然和白袍青年看着林锋已经跑远的背影，不约而同冷哼一声：“胆小鬼。”
林锋不知道自己的行为正遭人鄙视，就算知道了也不会在乎。
当然要跑了，要是让小不点和老村长看到他这副样子，他还怎么装世外高人？
另一方面，林锋也需要尽快脱离流光剑宗三人的视线，为自己的出手做好准备。
不管双方谁胜谁负，林锋都会出手。
老桃树赢了，林锋自然不乐意，现在不仅仅是小不点的安全，他还要保证慕容嫣然三人虽败不死，能逃得性命，至少慕容嫣然这个小娘是绝对不能死的。
否则谁去萧家退婚？
可要是叶葛三人赢得太容易了，那对林锋来说也不是好事情，天知道他们会不会看中小不点的潜力，将之收入流光剑宗门下？
那林锋可就鸡飞蛋打了。
两败俱伤才是林锋最乐意看到的结果。
于是，小心翼翼的找个地方藏好，林锋取出北极天磁剑，密切关注战局。

白袍青年已经亮剑出鞘，先一步同老桃树交手。
只是练气十层的修为虽然不凡，斩落了几朵桃花，但却远不是老桃树对手。
当白袍青年的剑光即将要斩在树干上时，老桃树突然起了变化，树枝上的桃花齐齐冒出粉红色的云雾，连成一片将老桃树罩住。
白袍青年的剑光斩在粉红云雾上，顿时就像陷入流沙一样，寸步难行。
“孽障敢尔？”白袍青年脸色一变，想要召回飞剑，却被红雾吸住，任他如何努力也收不回来。
不仅如此，红雾还顺着白袍青年的法力一路侵蚀过来，反攻他自身，白袍青年顿时脸色酡红，仿佛醉酒一样，只能苦苦支撑。
局势急转直下，叶葛和慕容嫣然都是大惊，慕容嫣然想要出手相助，却被叶葛拦下：“这树妖有古怪，你别插手。”
叶葛伸手在半空中一划拉，发出一道无形剑气，割断了白袍青年同老桃树之间的联系，将白袍青年救下，交给慕容嫣然：“你们退下，我来对付此妖。”
说罢拔剑出鞘，向前刺击，也是一道金色剑光发出。
叶葛的剑光可就比白袍青年要威猛多了，犹如白虹经天，耀眼剑光直斩向老桃树。
老桃树故技重施，红雾越发浓郁，挡住叶葛的剑光，红雾泛起一圈圈水纹一样的波纹痕迹，叶葛这气势汹汹的一剑力量竟也被她化解了。
林锋暗叫一声：“幸好。”硬接筑基期修士叶葛一剑，这老桃树果然也有筑基期的实力。
幸亏自己之前没有鲁莽，否则就算有北极天磁剑，跑去单挑老桃树，也是肉包子打狗，有去无回。
叶葛冷哼一声，明亮剑光化为云雾，轰然膨胀，剑气扶摇直上，形成一道气势惊人的云柱。
云柱扩展到了极致，云雾直接炸裂开，化为蝗雨般的剑气，成千上万一起向着四面八方飞射。
老桃树不慌不忙，树枝上的桃花全部飘落，化为漫天花雨，向着叶葛这边激射而来。
不同于之前看似轻飘飘，混不着力的模样，这次的花瓣，就如同利箭一样，穿云裂石。
漫天花雨同无尽剑气在空中相遇，爆发出惊人的碰撞。
花瓣破碎，剑气消弭，双方交织在一起，天地间一片朦胧。
林锋躲在暗处，看得眉飞色舞：“这就是筑基期修士的实力了，果然有两把刷子。”

content_en:
Not to mention that Murong Yanran almost retched when she saw this tragic scene, Ye Ge and the young man in white robe also frowned and felt nauseated.
The old peach tree at the entrance of the village, with its charred and withered trunks and the delicate peach blossoms, creates a strong contrast in the eyes that makes people feel uncomfortable.
The more vibrant the peach blossoms are, the weirder they appear in this hell-like environment on earth.
Just as Lin Feng was about to speak, a commotion suddenly broke out in Stone Village, with adults shouting and cursing and children crying. Everyone fled out of the village from different directions, avoiding the old peach tree at the entrance of the village.
Lin Feng glanced around and saw bright red peach blossom petals flying in the air in the village, chasing behind the villagers.
Anyone caught in the flower petals will immediately have their life essence sucked out and turn into mummies.
Seeing the little one in the crowd struggling to cover the others and escaping with everyone, Lin Feng breathed a sigh of relief and secretly said he was lucky.
Fortunately, he met Murong Yanran and others, otherwise Lao Taoshu would have taken action so quickly, and he would not have been able to deal with this old monster.
Facing Tao Hua who was chasing him out of the village, Lin Feng yelled and ran away with his head in his hands. He seemed to be very frightened.
Murong Yanran and the young man in white robe looked at Lin Feng's running back and snorted in unison: "Coward."
Lin Feng didn't know that his behavior was being despised by others, and he wouldn't care even if he knew.
Of course he would run away. If the little boy and the old village chief saw him like this, how could he pretend to be an outsider?
On the other hand, Lin Feng also needed to get out of the sight of the three Liuguang Sword Sect members as soon as possible to prepare for his attack.
No matter who wins or loses, Lin Feng will take action.
Lin Feng was naturally not happy that Lao Taoshu had won. Now, not only was the little one safe, he also had to ensure that Murong Yanran and the others could escape with their lives even if they were defeated. At least Murong Yanran, the little girl, could never die.
Otherwise, who would go to the Xiao family to break off the engagement?
But if Ye Ge and the others win too easily, it will not be a good thing for Lin Feng. Who knows if they will take a fancy to the little boy's potential and bring him under the Flowing Light Sword Sect?
Then Lin Feng was beaten.
Losing both sides is the result Lin Feng is most happy to see.
So, carefully finding a place to hide it, Lin Feng took out the Arctic Magnetic Sword and paid close attention to the battle situation.
The young man in white robe had drawn his sword out of its scabbard and was the first to fight against the old peach tree.
It's just that although the cultivation level of the tenth level of Qi training is extraordinary and he has chopped off a few peach blossoms, he is far from the match of the old peach tree.
When the white-robed young man's sword light was about to strike the tree trunk, the old peach tree suddenly changed. The peach blossoms on the branches all emitted pink clouds, forming a single sheet and covering the old peach tree.
The sword light of the white-robed young man struck the pink cloud, and he felt like he was stuck in quicksand, unable to move even an inch.
"How dare you?" The white-robed young man's expression changed. He wanted to recall the flying sword, but it was sucked into the red mist. No matter how hard he tried, he couldn't take it back.
Not only that, the red mist also eroded along the mana of the young man in white robe and counterattacked him. The young man in white robe suddenly turned red, as if he was drunk, and could only hold on.
The situation took a turn for the worse. Both Ye Ge and Murong Yanran were shocked. Murong Yanran wanted to help, but was stopped by Ye Ge: "This tree demon is weird, don't interfere."
Ye Ge reached out and swiped in mid-air, sending out an invisible sword energy that cut off the connection between the young man in white robe and the old peach tree. He rescued the young man in white robe and handed it over to Murong Yanran: "You guys step back, I will deal with this monster."
After saying that, he drew his sword out of its sheath and thrust forward, a golden sword light also emitted.
Ye Ge's sword light was much more powerful than that of the white-robed young man. Like a white rainbow in the sky, the dazzling sword light slashed straight at the old peach tree.
The old peach tree repeated its old tricks, and the red mist became thicker and thicker, blocking Ye Ge's sword light. The red mist created circles of water-like ripples, and the power of Ye Ge's menacing sword was actually resolved by her.
Lin Feng secretly shouted: "Fortunately. "Forcibly taking over the sword from Ye Ge, a monk in the Foundation Establishment stage, this old peach tree indeed has the strength of the Foundation Establishment stage.
Fortunately, I had not been reckless before, otherwise even if I had the North Pole Sky Magnetic Sword, I would have gone out to challenge the old peach tree, and it would have been like a meat bun beating a dog, and there would be no return.
Ye Ge snorted coldly, and the bright sword light turned into clouds, expanded suddenly, and the sword energy soared upward, forming an astonishing cloud pillar.
The cloud pillar expanded to the extreme, and the clouds and mist exploded directly, turning into sword energy like a rain of locusts, and thousands of them flew in all directions.
The old peach tree was unhurried, and all the peach blossoms on the branches fell down, turning into a rain of flowers all over the sky, shooting towards Ye Ge.
Different from the previous appearance, which seemed light and indifferent, this time the petals were like sharp arrows, piercing the clouds and cracking the rocks.
The sky-wide rain of flowers and the endless sword energy met in the air, and an astonishing collision broke out.
The petals shattered, the sword energy disappeared, the two sides intertwined, and the world became hazy.
Lin Feng hid in the dark, watching with excitement: "This is the strength of the foundation-building monks, and they really have two brushes. "
